items.source: Convert an array of MBeanParameterInfo into an array of Class instances corresponding to the parameters.
items.translation: 将 `MBeanParameterInfo` 数组转换为对应参数的 `Class` 实例数组。

items.source:
This implementation returns the superclass for a CGLIB proxy and
the class of the given bean else (for a JDK proxy or a plain bean class).
items.translation: 此实现为 CGLIB 代理返回父类，否则（针对 JDK 代理或普通 Bean 类）返回给定 Bean 的类。

items.source: Attempt to find a locally running MBeanServer. Fails if no MBeanServer can be found. Logs a warning if more than one MBeanServer found, returning the first one from the list.
items.translation: 尝试查找本地运行的 `MBeanServer`。如果找不到任何 `MBeanServer`，则失败。如果发现多个 `MBeanServer`，则记录警告信息并返回列表中的第一个。

items.source: MBeanServerNotFoundException - if no MBeanServer could be found
items.translation: `MBeanServerNotFoundException` - 如果找不到 `MBeanServer`

items.source: ClassNotFoundException - if a parameter type could not be resolved
items.translation: ClassNotFoundException - 如果无法解析参数类型

items.source: the MBeanServer if found
items.translation: 如果找到MBeanServer，则使用它。

items.source: paramInfo - the JMX parameter info
items.translation: paramInfo - JMX 参数信息

items.source: the parameter types as classes
items.translation: 参数类型作为类

items.source: When using strict casing, a JavaBean property with a getter method such as getFoo() translates to an attribute called Foo. With strict casing disabled, getFoo() would translate to just foo.
items.translation: 使用严格大小写时，具有 `getFoo()` 等 getter 方法的 JavaBean 属性会转换为名为`Foo`的属性。禁用严格大小写后，`getFoo()`将仅转换为`foo`。

items.source: This implementation checks for DynamicMBean classes as well as classes with corresponding "*MBean" interface (Standard MBeans) or corresponding "*MXBean" interface (Java MXBeans).
items.translation: 此实现会检查 `DynamicMBean` 类，以及具有相应 "*MBean" 接口（标准 MBeans）或相应 "*MXBean" 接口（Java MXBeans）的类。

items.source: Append an additional key/value pair to an existing ObjectName with the key being the static value identity and the value being the identity hash code of the managed resource being exposed on the supplied ObjectName. This can be used to provide a unique ObjectName for each distinct instance of a particular bean or class. Useful when generating ObjectNames at runtime for a set of managed resources based on the template value supplied by a ObjectNamingStrategy.
items.translation: 向现有的 ObjectName 追加一个额外的键/值对，其中键为静态值 identity，值为在提供的 ObjectName 上暴露的受管资源的身份哈希码。这可用于为特定 bean 或类的每个不同实例提供唯一的 ObjectName。当基于 ObjectNamingStrategy 提供的模板值在运行时为一组受管资源生成 ObjectNames 时非常有用。

items.source: The key used when extending an existing ObjectName with the identity hash code of its corresponding managed resource.
items.translation: 扩展现有 ObjectName 时使用的键，其值为对应管理资源的身份哈希码。

items.translation: 尝试查找本地运行的MBeanServer。

items.source: Create a String[] representing the argument signature of a method. Each element in the array is the fully qualified class name of the corresponding argument in the method's signature.
items.translation: 创建一个 `String[]` 来表示方法的参数签名。数组中的每个元素是方法签名中对应参数的完全限定类名。

items.source:
Collection of generic utility methods to support Spring JMX.
Includes a convenient method to locate an MBeanServer.
items.translation: 包含用于支持 Spring JMX 的通用实用方法的集合。包括一个方便定位 MBeanServer 的方法。

items.source:
Return the Standard MBean interface for the given class, if any
(that is, an interface whose name matches the class name of the
given class but with suffix "MBean").
items.translation: 返回给定类的标准 MBean 接口（如果有），即名称与给定类名匹配但后缀为"MBean"的接口。

items.source:
Return the Java MXBean interface for the given class, if any
(that is, an interface whose name ends with "MXBean" and/or
carries an appropriate MXBean annotation).
items.translation: 返回给定类的 Java MXBean 接口（如果有），即名称以 "MXBean" 结尾和/或带有适当 MXBean 注解的接口。

items.source: agentId - the agent identifier of the MBeanServer to retrieve. If this parameter is null, all registered MBeanServers are considered. If the empty String is given, the platform MBeanServer will be returned.
items.translation: agentId - 要检索的 MBeanServer 的代理标识符。如果此参数为 null，则考虑所有已注册的 MBeanServer。如果给定空字符串，将返回平台 MBeanServer。
